title: Mix of HDR and non-HDR cameras breaks rendering

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: S-Needs-Review
labels.description: Needs reviewer attention (from anyone!) to move forward

body:
## Bevy version

0.9 and main

## Relevant system information

```
AdapterInfo { name: "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070", vendor: 4318, device: 7938, device_type: DiscreteGpu, driver: "NVIDIA", driver_info: "517.48", backend: Vulkan }
```

## What you did

Change the `split_screen.rs` example to add `hdr: true` on one camera but not the other (doesn't matter which one).

## What went wrong

Background becomes black, default clear color (grey) not applied anymore. I **both** cases (whether hdr is set on left or right), only the _right_ camera shows something. 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6532395/204041789-6f3518af-6701-4e14-b835-7a275dbf0235.png)

Testing this on another 4-camera 🎆 Hanabi example, where things animate, I can confirm clearing doesn't work (all particles render on the previous frame) and the HDR camera stops rendering:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6532395/204041891-998d3c55-346d-4730-ad0c-c2a1a8ded074.png)

Although the latter _could_ be a bug in 🎆 Hanabi, the similarity of artifacts might help diagnosing the issue.

## Additional information

I'm guessing the cameras have incompatible render target, and there's no "smart" resolution applying tonemapping only to HDR ones.

It's unclear if this is supposed to work in the first place but logged as bug because @superdump said it should "maybe" be supported.
